conditions: The claim concerns the generated copy function of a valid data class, using its primary-constructor data properties.
limitations: This does not specify general cloning, preservation of body-only properties, or the behavior of a separate same-name overload.

triggers: Recheck any publisher correction, source integrity change, or contrary evidence about the pinned RFC edition.

statement: The Kotlin/Core 1.9 RFC describes a generated data-class copy function as a shallow copy operation with primary-constructor parameters whose defaults come from the corresponding properties of the receiver.
